scope: Independent local source/control review; no new workload, no SDK artifact or full performance qualification.
equivalence_boundaries: Fast path requires exactly A or AAAA and absence of any configured raw record of that type. Even an unrelated-owner raw A/AAAA keeps the general path.

The address-family block is moved byte-for-byte, including interface-source precedence, DHCPv4 records, Hosts rotation/no-round-robin, localise filtering, logging notices and cached-candidate suppression of synthesis.
General path passes the original rows vector, preserving configured raw/TXT/PTR prefixes. Its original ownership is ORed with helper ownership; raw address rows still suppress synthetic answers.
The helper does not read the incoming owned flag, so a fresh helper-local false plus caller OR is equivalent to the original monotonic true assignments.
The skipped TXT/MX/SRV/NAPTR helpers immediately reject A/AAAA before contributions or rotations. PTR/reverse synthesis and SRV rotation were guarded by other qtypes.
CNAME selection/chaining happens before this collector, and CNAME-only ownership remains with the unchanged caller. Empty ordinary A/AAAA returns rows empty/owned false/reverse false.
ANY/PTR/mail ordering and their existing shared rows path remain unchanged. The reliable raw-type index is maintained alongside private raw records.
tests_reviewed: Fast result versus general fallback forced by unrelated raw A/AAAA, across host/alias/missing names and an interleaved A/AAAA/TXT/MX/ANY sequence to detect rotation differences.
Same-owner raw A/AAAA must precede host address rows; a raw synthesized-name A suppresses synthesis.

retained_control_evidence.control_limit: These probe checksums summarize answer lengths, not byte-for-byte wire identity. Source equivalence and existing response tests support this narrow step; full boundary/family comparisons remain required for F.

aslr_control_note: Unchanged Hosts::name_hash_bucket incorporates relocated typestr pointer bytes and rotation copies a bucket. The individual-process host-localise allocation difference is retained and not used alone to infer candidate benefit or regression.
